description:
We’re tackling Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots: 

I’m a final-year AI & ML student at TU Dublin with experience in data pipelines and time-series analysis (Python, PostgreSQL). I’ll handle data cleaning and the harmonization itself.

Looking for: data scientists / analysts (statistics, time series, anomaly detection), someone strong in data visualization, and ideally a frontend or full-stack dev for the interactive map. No fire or remote sensing expertise needed, just message me!
